title: Fatigue Crack Evaluation with the Guided Wave-Convolutional Neural Network Ensemble and Differential Wavelet Spectrogram.
summary: A guided-wave CNN ensemble estimated fatigue-crack length on a tested lap-joint specimen; on held-out specimen D6 the reported RMSE was 1.7 mm, with crack lengths followed during fatigue loading.
ai_technology: Differential time-frequency spectrograms from guided-wave signals were inputs to 20 CNNs; trained on specimens D1–D5, Methods §§2–3.
organization: Research Center of Structural Health Monitoring and Prognosis

evidence.tested: Results §4 evaluates specimen D6 and reports agreement with measured crack lengths; maximum error 3 mm and RMSE 1.7 mm.
evidence.unknown: One held-out specimen, 77 training images and laboratory fatigue testing; authors note small training data and dependence on collected training data.
evidence.ai_role: Differential time-frequency spectrograms from guided-wave signals were inputs to 20 CNNs; trained on specimens D1–D5, Methods §§2–3.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
